verdict.rationale: Devin's Knowledge feature is a first-party store of instructions that Devin references in all sessions, so cross-session recall is documented. Nothing in the pack shows Devin building or updating that memory on its own; Knowledge and AGENTS.md read as user-supplied context. Missing for 10: evidence that Devin captures and builds memory automatically from its work, details of how recall is triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of persistence across sessions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: Knowledge is a collection of instructions and advice that Devin can reference in all sessions.
it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling
